name: Release v0.8.32
body:
## Snow CLI v0.8.32

### What's New

- Enhanced image content processing: images in data URL, http(s) URL, or raw base64 format are now handled uniformly, with bare base64 automatically completed into a data URL to prevent 400 errors from servers that reject malformed image URLs
- Optimized inline image sending for tool messages: images are inlined as image_url content blocks within the tool message itself (DeepSeek Vision scheme), instead of being split into separate user messages
- Profile switching safety: configuration updates now read the active profile's current content from disk before writing back, so a profile switched elsewhere (e.g., via Alt+P in another session or instance) is no longer overwritten with stale in-memory baseUrl/apiKey values
- New SNOW_CONFIG_DIR environment variable to override the Snow global config directory (default ~/.snow), useful for multi-environment and test isolation

### Installation
```bash
npm install -g snow-ai
```

### Usage
```bash
snow
```
### Update
```bash
snow --update
```
